method: stdlib ZIP / allowlisted pickle metadata / struct scalar arithmetic
linear_prediction_analysis_scope: derived_posthoc_descriptive; no new qualification or selection gate
limits: Recomputes saved gradient/FD arithmetic, not model derivatives or imagined costs themselves.
Each point gradient is inferred from adjacent accumulated prefixes times27; its norm is checked against the receipt. Independent per-point gradient tensors were not archived.
The recovered27-point mean check is an archive-consistency check, not an independent BPTT validation.
Runtime model and preexisting .grad preservation are producer receipts; persisted source/checkpoint identities are independently hashed.
A negative actual parameter-delta dot old gradient is only a local first-order prediction, not measured post-update model loss or physical improvement.
The row bound applies at the same latent; it does not bound different closed-loop states or trajectories.
Only COMPLETE recorded stages are accepted; this tool never upgrades a partial run to COMPLETE.
